title: Former Shin Bet Chief Ronen Bar Sues Netanyahu Over October 7 Claims
detail: France 24 reports that former Shin Bet chief Ronen Bar has sued Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over his claims about October 7. Per Ynet, the defamation suit in Tel Aviv District Court seeks NIS 3 million and the disclosure of intelligence assessments and security-discussion records; Bar says Netanyahu falsely accused him of knowingly withholding warnings, that an alert went out at 3:03 a.m. on Oct. 7, and that Netanyahu did not return his calls. The filing lists warnings from November 2022 to October 2023, while Bar acknowledges Shin Bet failures. Netanyahu called the suit a publicity stunt and said Bar had his 'red phone' number. Venue and filing date are reported inconsistently across outlets.

media.caption: Ronen Bar sues Netanyahu over Oct. 7 accusations
